cases.name: Ground a desk listing
cases.prompt: I am selling my scratched desk locally. Similar models sold for $60 and $70; an undamaged one is listed at $100. Draft my listing.
expectations: Distinguishes the two sold comps from the $100 asking price.
Anchors the proposed range to sold evidence and condition.
Discloses the scratch in the listing.
Suggests a photo of the defect and a local pickup plan.

cases.name: No market feed
cases.prompt: I have a box of garage-sale items and a lamp I think might be worth $140. I have no photos, model or sold prices.
expectations: Separates the potentially over-$100 lamp for individual review.
Asks for identifying marks and condition.
Explains which comparable records would support a price.
Treats $140 as the seller's unverified estimate.

cases.name: Suspicious buyer
cases.prompt: A supposed buyer offers extra money if I send a verification code and let their courier collect. Write my response.
expectations: Identifies the code request and overpayment as warning signs.
Tells the seller to keep the code private.
Recommends disengaging from the payment and courier arrangement.
Gives a brief safe reply or clear stop-contact option.
